items.name: Wet
items.source: Apply the Wet Spray from the Gear Shop, or let it land during a Rain event.
items.cardSummary: The cheapest mutation and a common early upgrade while you build cash.

items.name: Frozen
items.source: Apply the Frozen Spray from the Gear Shop, or let it land during a Blizzard event.
items.cardSummary: A modest step up from Wet once your farm can spare the spray cost.

items.name: Autumn
items.source: Apply the Autumn Spray from the Gear Shop, or let it land during an Autumn weather event.
items.cardSummary: Doubles crop value and is a reliable mid-tier spray buy.

items.name: Void
items.source: Apply the Void Spray from the Gear Shop, or let it land during a Black Hole event.
items.cardSummary: A small bump over Autumn and the first billion-tier spray.

items.name: Radioactive
items.source: Apply the Radioactive Spray from the Gear Shop, or let it land during a Nuclear event.
items.cardSummary: Triples crop value and is a strong target once you reach the billions.

items.name: Rainbow
items.source: Apply the Rainbow Spray from the Gear Shop, or let it land during a Galaxy event.
items.cardSummary: A big five-times jump and the first trillion-tier spray purchase.

items.name: Cosmic
items.source: Apply the Cosmic Spray, sold in the Gear Shop and also available through the Plant Rush shop.
items.cardSummary: A high spray-only multiplier for established farms with deep cash reserves.

items.name: Bubblegum
items.source: Apply the Bubblegum Spray from the Gear Shop.
items.cardSummary: One of the strongest buyable mutations, saved for high-value crops.

items.name: Fire
items.source: Apply the Fire Spray from the Gear Shop.
items.cardSummary: The highest multiplier in the game and the top endgame spray target.

items.name: Farm
items.source: Apply the Trucker Spray from the Gear Shop, or let it land during a Trucker event.
items.cardSummary: A four-times boost; public guides do not list its current spray price.

items.name: Alien
items.source: Only lands during the Alien (UFO) weather event; it cannot be bought as a spray.
items.cardSummary: Event-only roll, so you have to wait for the UFO event to chase it.

items.name: Admin
items.source: Only granted during Admin Abuse events run by the developers; not for sale.
items.cardSummary: Tied to developer-run events, so it is not something you can plan around.

items.name: Honeycomb
items.source: Only lands during the rare Queen Bee event; it cannot be bought as a spray.
items.cardSummary: A rare event roll with one of the lowest chances on the list.

items.name: Starfall
items.source: Applied by the Starfall Griffin pet rather than a spray or weather event.
items.cardSummary: Stacks on top of another mutation, so it can multiply an existing boost.

items.name: Carnival
items.source: Apply the Carnival Spray, pulled from Spray Crates earned through the Carnival Pass and Carnival Crate.
items.cardSummary: Added in Update 5; it stacks like Starfall and comes from crate rewards.
